messages:
Riley: Quick note 1 put new side-panel audit flow in Figma: https://figma.com/file/sidepanel
Tess: Looks cleaner than navigating away. Side-panel keeps context, 👍
Noah: A11y: when panel opens move focus to the panel title and set aria-modal/trap. Close button needs aria-label and visible focus
Mina: Invite flow: bulk paste must tokenise. Show invalid tokens as red pills and announce '3 invalid emails' via aria-live after parse
Oliver: SSO copy: change 'Require SSO' -> 'SSO enforcement' and show sublabel options 'All users / Admins only' for clarity
Riley: Also unify CTA copy to 'Send invitations' across drawer and modal
Tess: Visual nit: audit timestamps at 12px fail contrast at small widths. Bump to 13px semibold or increase color contrast
Noah: Keyboard bug: tab order jumps to footer buttons before form. Need initial focus on first input and restore focus on close
Mina: Dev note: encode filters/sort in query params so deep links and shareable views keep state
Oliver: Filed ENG-12501 for focus-trap + URL-state work with repro steps attached
design-bot: Frames uploaded: sidepanel-audit-v1, invite-tokenise-v2, sso-labels
Riley: Next steps 1 Tess to update copy + contrast, Noah to run keyboard-only pass, Mina to do screen-reader review
Tess: I'll add the copy variants in Figma comments :memo:
